statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-6732 is a type confusion in libxml2 XSD (XML Schema Definition) streaming validation triggered through xmlParseReference. The harbor-db image uses libxml2 only as a shared library dependency of the PostgreSQL server built with --with-libxml. Inspection of exported symbols in /opt/postgresql/15/bin/postgres and /opt/postgresql/15/lib/pgxml.so shows that no PostgreSQL binary or extension in this image imports any xmlSchema* function or xmlParseReference. Harbor's database schema does not exercise PostgreSQL XML features, and no xmllint or xmlcatalog CLI is present. The vulnerable XSD validation code path is therefore unreachable from any code in this image.

This CVE is a memory leak in the xmllint interactive shell. The WordPress image only includes the libxml2 shared library, not the xmllint binary (provided by libxml2-utils). The vulnerable code is not present in the image.
